label: Well-founded necessary support union, from rigid ascent in esse and no infinite ascent
description: Derives J2 of the join without the one-way no-novel-edge condition, actual well-founded grounding or reflexive access. Every edge of the cross-world union of support among necessary concreta is, by the rigid ascent premise, a step up in the one world-invariant comparative MoreIn esse, which has no infinite ascent among necessary concreta. Because the grade takes no world argument, edges at different worlds are measured by one order, which is what the world-varying rivals deny. Not comparable in strength with the no-novel-edge route: Control.OffWorldAscent satisfies the ascent premise and no infinite ascent while no-novel-edge fails; and with a freely chosen grade, J2 itself yields such a grade (gradedOfUnionWF). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
